matches.rationale: Ground truth 1 concerns an overstated claim in the Abstract about performance improvements being presented without sufficient qualification. None of the findings address the Abstract's claims or rhetorical overstatement of experimental results.

Ground truth 2 identifies fabricated future references (2024-2025 citations) in the Introduction that falsely suggest established literature. None of the findings discuss citation issues or reference fabrication.

Ground truth 3 concerns an incorrect closed-form formula in Proposition 1 (missing normalization/softmax). Finding 1 addresses a different equation (Equation 5, the conditional velocity simplification), and Finding 4 addresses Appendix A.1 derivation steps, but neither identifies the core issue of missing normalization in Proposition 1's statement (Equation 6).
Ground truth 4 concerns omission of data augmentation details in the experimental protocol. None of the findings mention data augmentation or experimental setup omissions.
Ground truth 5 concerns Figure 2's memorization metric being truncated/rescaled and missing error bars. None of the findings discuss Figure 2, plotting issues, or missing variance reporting.

Both ground truth 6 and finding 2 identify the same contradiction: Proposition 2 claims the estimator is unbiased, but the main text hedges and states it 'does not guarantee unbiasedness in the standard Monte Carlo sense.' This is the same internal inconsistency about the bias claim for the empirical flow matching estimator.

Ground truth 7 concerns overly promotional language ('consistent modest but steady improvements') in describing Figure 4 results. None of the findings address rhetorical tone or presentation manipulation in the experiments section.

Ground truth 8 identifies a contradiction between the Conclusion's claim to 'clarify' generalization and the Limitations section's admission of major unexplored factors. None of the findings discuss the Conclusion or cross-section coherence between claims and limitations.
Ground truth 9 concerns insufficient discussion of privacy risks and mitigation in the broader impact section. None of the findings address ethical considerations or the broader impact statement.

Ground truth 10 concerns understated computational overhead claims for empirical flow matching in the Method section. None of the findings discuss computational efficiency claims or experimental protocol regarding resource usage.
Ground truth 11 concerns omitted/fabricated results for M ≥ 1000 in empirical flow matching experiments. None of the findings discuss missing experimental results or selective reporting of M values.
Ground truth 12 concerns promotional language ('remarkable agreement,' 'clearly answers') in the Related Work section. None of the findings address rhetorical issues in the related work discussion.

Ground truth 13 identifies a narrative contradiction between Section 3.1 (claiming stochasticity is short/unimportant) and earlier sections (emphasizing stochasticity as important). None of the findings discuss this cross-section thematic inconsistency about the role of stochasticity.
